text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-48217 - inference-eu-5xx-rate spike in eu-west-1 (service: redwood-inference-runtime). Trigger: 5xx rate > 4% for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-48217

maya: saw this come through on my phone but was driving, couldn't ack. sorry, just saw now.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation step 1: primary (maya) notified at 2026-03-14T02:12:03Z — no ack within 2m -> Escalation step 2: secondary (jordan) paged at 2026-03-14T02:14:03Z.

jordan: acked at 02:14:47, jumping in. quick checks: k8s shows increased restarts on inference-pool-eu-5.

alex: what do dashboards show? any customer-facing errors?

jordan: grafana: spikes in 500s from model-router for routes pinned to gptq-2. Snapshot: 5xx rate 6.8% in last 3m. lat p95 up from 180ms -> 480ms.

sara: I'm opening a temporary mitigation: route traffic away from eu-west-1 canary pool to eu-west-2 fallback. will push a routing override.

emily: +1, we should also disable the autoscaler for that pool to prevent churn while we triage.

jordan: doing a quick rollout of route override:
```bash
# route override to fallback region
redwoodctl routes set --route model=gptq-2 --from-region eu-west-1 --to-region eu-west-2 --ttl 300
```

pagerduty-bot: Escalation step 3: manager (oncall-manager) paged at 2026-03-14T02:17:03Z due to no ack from primary within policy window.

oncall-manager: I saw the manager page, standby. if routing override works can we confirm customer impact? any active incidents from enterprise customers?

jordan: routing override applied at 02:17:50. delta: traffic shifted ~43% in 30s. 5xx rate trending down to 1.3% now. p95 back to ~210ms.

maya: acked the original PD at 02:20:05 (still DND issue on phone last night causing delay). apologies for the late ack.

pagerduty-bot: Note: primary ack occurred after secondary had already taken action. No duplicate action required but record for postmortem.

alex: any customer-facing errors logged? SLO breach?

jordan: severity: partial, brief. We saw ~1.9k failed requests across all customers over a 7-minute window. Affected routes were mostly dedicated customer pools on gptq-2 in eu-west-1. No complete outage.

sara: outreach recommendation: notify affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps. Ops-runbook suggests "inform and offer token refunds" for dedicated SLA customers if errors > 1% for >10m. This was <10m but close.

emily: can we collect request_ids for failed spans and surface to support? I'll export logs now.

jordan: running quick query:
```sql
SELECT request_id, customer_id, status, timestamp
FROM request_logs
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND status LIKE '5%%' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
LIMIT 2000;
```

pagerduty-bot: PD-48217 resolved by manual mitigation (traffic reroute) at 2026-03-14T02:22:38Z. Incident closed by jordan.

maya: re: missed ack — I had phone DND scheduled accidentally. I'll update my oncall profile to send SMS for critical pages.

oncall-manager: please also update escalation policy to shorten manager page window to 90s for the critical inference service, per today's near-miss. I'll file a config change request.

alex: follow-ups:
- RCA: why gptq-2 pool started returning 5xxs (resource exhaustion? model load churn?)
- Improve alerting: add synthetic probe for model-router responses to catch rising error rate before customer impact
- Process: confirm oncall contact preferences and test PD mobile alerts

sara: assigning tasks: jordan -> collect logs + pod diagnostics; emily -> export request_ids and hand to support; maya -> PD oncall preferences update; oncall-manager -> create escalation policy PR.

jordan: I grabbed pod logs: stack traces show OOMKilled on model-worker-67 and model-worker-82 around 02:10:20. suspect memory regression from last quantization change. saving logs to /var/log/incident/PD-48217-logs.tgz and uploading to the incident drive.

emily: support contact: pinging #customer-success to prepare a short note.

incident-bot: incident summary saved to /incidents/PD-48217/summary.md by jordan.

oncall-manager: good mitigation. Let's keep the incident thread open until we have the RCA and PD policy PR. Marking severity as "SEV3" for tracking.

maya: thanks team. I'll do a quick follow-up in the morning (local) to finalize the postmortem. :eyes:
